summary.data_analytics: Evaluation and data systems professional with 5 years supporting 4 shelter sites serving 400+ people/month and their integrated clinical partnerships. Led mixed methods efforts including surveys and focus groups, built reporting workflows, and translated findings into funder-ready narratives and operational decisions. Experienced with Python/SQL, SPSS, dashboards, and Microsoft 365 automation. Committed to equity-centered learning and improving health and housing outcomes.

projects.name: Intan acquisition and experiment synchronization

projects.name: Waveform discrimination and online sorting research
projects.problem: Preserve unit-specific waveform information while investigating streaming analysis.

bullets.text: Implemented WeightBank waveform representations in spike_discrim; evaluated post-hoc clustering against putative O-Sort unit labels.
Developed synthetic streaming/detection infrastructure in realtime-sorter-mvp and experimental competitive-learning sorting in SNNeuro.

projects.status: Discrimination evaluated offline; online unit sorting remains experimental, without validated end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Single-neuron response analysis and semantic tuning
projects.problem: Investigate relationships between stimulus meaning and single-neuron responses.

bullets.text: Implemented a seeded NEURON prototype mapping sentence similarity to stochastic input rates, with fixed synaptic weights.
Developed semantic-trajectory tooling in ZEmbeddings; exploring stimulus-aligned response analysis and adaptive stimulus selection.

projects.status: Simulation and text analysis implemented; adaptive experiments proposed, not demonstrated human concept selectivity or causality.

site.intro_title: Neural acquisition, spike processing, and single-neuron response analysis
site.intro_blurb: I'm a biomedical engineering master's student at UC Davis working with Dr. Jie Zheng's lab on human single-unit electrophysiology. I build research software for neural acquisition and spike analysis. My current interests center on Intan acquisition, real-time spike sorting, and investigating semantic selectivity in single-neuron responses.
